source.text: וּמִן־הַתְּכֵ֤לֶת וְהָֽאַרְגָּמָן֙ וְתוֹלַ֣עַת הַשָּׁנִ֔י עָשׂ֥וּ בִגְדֵי־שְׂרָ֖ד לְשָׁרֵ֣ת בַּקֹּ֑דֶשׁ וַֽיַּעֲשׂ֞וּ אֶת־בִּגְדֵ֤י הַקֹּ֨דֶשׁ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לְאַהֲרֹ֔ן כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־מֹשֶֽׁה׃פ

records.literal_gloss: And from the violet and the purple and the scarlet of crimson they made garments of woven work for serving in the holy [place]; and they made the garments of holiness which [are] for Aaron, as had commanded Yahweh Moses.

en.L: And from the blue and the purple and the scarlet [yarn] they made woven garments for serving in the holy [place]; and they made the garments of holiness which [were] for Aaron, as {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had commanded Moses.
en.B: Out of blue, purple and scarlet yarn, finely woven garments were made for service in the holy place. Aaron's holy garments were made as well, as {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had commanded Moses.
en.R: The workers used blue, purple and red yarn to weave the special clothes worn for serving in the holy place. They made the holy clothes for Aaron, as {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had commanded Moses.

es.L: Y del [hilo] azul y púrpura y escarlata hicieron vestiduras tejidas para ministrar en el [lugar] santo; e hicieron las vestiduras de santidad que [eran] para Aarón, como {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} había mandado a Moisés.
es.B: Con hilo azul, púrpura y escarlata se hicieron vestiduras finamente tejidas para el servicio en el lugar santo. También se hicieron las vestiduras sagradas de Aarón, como {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} había mandado a Moisés.
es.R: Los artesanos usaron hilo azul, púrpura y rojo para tejer la ropa especial que se usaba para servir en el lugar santo. Hicieron la ropa santa para Aarón, como {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} había mandado a Moisés.

fr.L: Et du [fil] bleu et pourpre et écarlate ils firent des vêtements tissés pour officier dans le [lieu] saint ; et ils firent les vêtements de sainteté qui [étaient] pour Aaron, comme {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} l’avait ordonné à Moïse.
fr.B: Avec le fil bleu, pourpre et écarlate, on fit des vêtements finement tissés pour le service dans le lieu saint. On fit aussi les vêtements sacrés d’Aaron, comme {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} l’avait ordonné à Moïse.
fr.R: Les artisans ont utilisé du fil bleu, pourpre et rouge pour tisser les vêtements spéciaux que l’on portait pour servir dans le lieu saint. Ils ont fait les vêtements saints d’Aaron, comme {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} l’avait ordonné à Moïse.

sw.L: Na kwa [uzi wa] samawati na zambarau na rangi nyekundu wakafanya mavazi yaliyofumwa kwa ajili ya kuhudumu katika [mahali] patakatifu; wakafanya mavazi ya utakatifu yaliyokuwa ya Haruni, kama {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alivyomwamuru Musa.
sw.B: Kwa uzi wa samawati, wa zambarau na wa rangi nyekundu yalishonwa mavazi yaliyofumwa kwa ustadi kwa ajili ya huduma katika mahali patakatifu. Mavazi matakatifu ya Haruni nayo yalishonwa, kama {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alivyomwamuru Musa.
sw.R: Mafundi walitumia uzi wa samawati, wa zambarau na mwekundu kufuma mavazi maalum ya kuhudumu mahali patakatifu. Walimshonea Haruni mavazi matakatifu, kama {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alivyomwamuru Musa.

decisions.choice: they made the holy garments: the garments of chapter 28 are made
decisions.reason: Verses 1-31 tell how the priestly garments described in 28:1-43 were made, in nearly the same words, now told as done. The order differs a little: the ephod, the breastpiece, the robe, and then the tunics, turban, caps, undergarments and sash, ending with the gold plate. The workers are the skilled men and women led by Bezalel and Oholiab (35:30-36:2).

decisions.choice: woven garments: the priests' finely worked clothing
decisions.reason: See the note at 31:10. The phrase that follows, "for serving in the holy place", says what these garments were for.

decisions.choice: as Yahweh had commanded Moses: the refrain of the chapter
decisions.reason: These words close seven sections of verses 1-31 (verses 1, 5, 7, 21, 26, 29, 31): the garments as a whole, the band of the ephod, the onyx stones, the breastpiece, the robe, the linen garments and sash, and the plate on the turban. Each part is marked as made exactly as God had commanded. Nothing in the clothing is the workers' own design; all follows the pattern God gave Moses on the mountain (25:9, 40). The refrain comes again in the summary (verses 32, 42, 43) and through chapter 40 as the tabernacle is set up.

decisions.choice: as the LORD had commanded Moses
decisions.reason: The refrain is worded the same way at every level and in every verse, so that the reader hears the repetition (m3). The past perfect shows that the command came before the work.

decisions.choice: were made (Balanced); The workers (Readable)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says only "they". Balanced uses the passive and Readable names the workers, the craftsmen of 35:30-36:2. Readable says "red" for "scarlet", as in 28:5.

decisions.choice: "como {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} había mandado a Moisés" at every level and in every verse
decisions.reason: The refrain closes each section of the chapter (m3), so Spanish keeps one wording throughout, as the English does; French and Swahili do the same ("l'avait ordonné à Moïse", "alivyomwamuru Musa").

decisions.choice: passé simple at Literal and Balanced ("firent", "battirent", "attachèrent"); passé composé at Readable ("ont fait", "ont attaché")
decisions.reason: As in the other narrative chapters of Exodus (docs/french-style.md, section 3): the passé simple is the tense of written narrative, the passé composé the tense of everyday telling. Balanced uses an impersonal "on" where the English uses the passive.

source.text: וַיַּ֖עַשׂ אֶת־הָאֵפֹ֑ד זָהָ֗ב תְּכֵ֧לֶת וְאַרְגָּמָ֛ן וְתוֹלַ֥עַת שָׁנִ֖י וְשֵׁ֥שׁ מָשְׁזָֽר׃

records.literal_gloss: And he made the ephod: gold, violet and purple and scarlet of crimson and fine twisted linen.

en.L: And he made the ephod [of] gold, blue and purple and scarlet [yarn] and fine twisted linen.
en.B: Bezalel made the ephod from gold, blue, purple and scarlet yarn, and fine twisted linen.
en.R: Bezalel made the ephod from gold thread, fine linen, and blue, purple and red yarn.

es.L: E hizo el efod [de] oro, [hilo] azul y púrpura y escarlata, y lino fino torcido.
es.B: Bezalel hizo el efod de oro, de hilo azul, púrpura y escarlata, y de lino fino torcido.
es.R: Bezalel hizo el efod con hilo de oro, lino fino e hilo azul, púrpura y rojo.

fr.L: Et il fit l’éphod [d’]or, [de fil] bleu et pourpre et écarlate, et de fin lin retors.
fr.B: Betsaleel fit l’éphod d’or, de fil bleu, pourpre et écarlate, et de fin lin retors.
fr.R: Betsaleel a fait l’éphod avec du fil d’or, du fin lin et du fil bleu, pourpre et rouge.

sw.L: Akaifanya efodi [kwa] dhahabu, [uzi wa] samawati na zambarau na rangi nyekundu, na kitani safi iliyosokotwa.
sw.B: Bezaleli aliifanya efodi kwa dhahabu, kwa uzi wa samawati, wa zambarau na wa rangi nyekundu, na kwa kitani safi iliyosokotwa.
sw.R: Bezaleli aliishona efodi kwa uzi wa dhahabu, kitani safi, na uzi wa samawati, wa zambarau na mwekundu.

decisions.choice: he made: Bezalel, the master craftsman
decisions.reason: The verb is singular. Bezalel is the craftsman God filled with skill (31:2-5; 35:30-35), and 37:1 and 38:22 say that he made the furnishings and all that Yahweh commanded Moses. The singular in this verse and in verses 7, 8 and 22 names him as the one in charge; elsewhere "they" are the workers with him.

decisions.choice: the ephod: as in 28:6
decisions.reason: See the notes at 28:6-8 on the ephod and its materials.

decisions.choice: Bezalel
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable name the one meant by "he" (m1), so that the change from "they" in verse 1 does not confuse. Literal keeps "he".

source.text: וַֽיְרַקְּע֞וּ אֶת־פַּחֵ֣י הַזָּהָב֮ וְקִצֵּ֣ץ פְּתִילִם֒ לַעֲשׂ֗וֹת בְּת֤וֹךְ הַתְּכֵ֨לֶת֙ וּבְת֣וֹךְ הָֽאַרְגָּמָ֔ן וּבְת֛וֹךְ תּוֹלַ֥עַת הַשָּׁנִ֖י וּבְת֣וֹךְ הַשֵּׁ֑שׁ מַעֲשֵׂ֖ה חֹשֵֽׁב׃

records.literal_gloss: And they beat out the plates of the gold and he cut threads to work [them] among the violet and among the purple and among the scarlet of crimson and among the fine linen, [the] work of a skilled designer.

en.L: And they beat out the gold [into] thin plates, and he cut [them into] threads, to work [them] in among the blue and among the purple and among the scarlet [yarn] and among the fine linen, [the] work of a skilled designer.
en.B: Gold was beaten into thin plates and cut into threads, which were worked in among the blue yarn, the purple, the scarlet and the fine linen with a designer's skill.
en.R: Workers hammered gold into thin sheets and cut them into threads. Then they wove the gold threads into the blue, purple and red yarn and the fine linen. It was the work of a skilled designer.

es.L: Y batieron el oro [en] láminas delgadas, y él [las] cortó [en] hilos, para entretejer[los] en medio del azul, y en medio de la púrpura, y en medio de la escarlata, y en medio del lino fino, obra de diseñador hábil.
es.B: El oro se batió en láminas delgadas que se cortaron en hilos, y estos se entretejieron con el hilo azul, la púrpura, la escarlata y el lino fino con arte de diseñador.
es.R: Los artesanos martillaron el oro hasta hacer láminas delgadas y las cortaron en hilos. Luego tejieron los hilos de oro junto con el hilo azul, púrpura y rojo y el lino fino. Fue obra de un diseñador hábil.

fr.L: Et ils battirent l’or [en] lames minces, et il [les] coupa [en] fils, pour [les] travailler au milieu du bleu, et au milieu de la pourpre, et au milieu de l’écarlate, et au milieu du fin lin, ouvrage de dessinateur habile.
fr.B: On battit l’or en lames minces, que l’on coupa en fils, et ces fils furent entrelacés avec le fil bleu, la pourpre, l’écarlate et le fin lin, avec l’art d’un dessinateur.
fr.R: Des artisans ont martelé l’or pour en faire de fines feuilles et les ont découpées en fils. Puis ils ont tissé ces fils d’or avec le fil bleu, pourpre et rouge et le fin lin. C’était l’ouvrage d’un dessinateur habile.

sw.L: Wakaifua dhahabu [kuwa] mabamba membamba, naye akayakata [kuwa] nyuzi, ili kuzifanyia kazi katikati ya samawati na katikati ya zambarau na katikati ya rangi nyekundu na katikati ya kitani safi, kazi ya mbunifu stadi.
sw.B: Dhahabu ilifuliwa kuwa mabamba membamba na kukatwa kuwa nyuzi, nazo zikafumwa pamoja na uzi wa samawati, wa zambarau, wa rangi nyekundu na kitani safi kwa ustadi wa mbunifu.
sw.R: Mafundi walifua dhahabu kuwa mabamba membamba, kisha wakayakata kuwa nyuzi. Wakazifuma nyuzi hizo za dhahabu pamoja na uzi wa samawati, wa zambarau na mwekundu, na kitani safi. Hiyo ilikuwa kazi ya mbunifu stadi.

decisions.choice: beat out plates of gold and cut threads: making gold thread
decisions.reason: The gold was hammered into thin sheets, then cut into narrow strips that could be woven in with the yarn and the linen. This detail is new: chapter 28 only names gold among the materials of the ephod (28:6).

decisions.choice: they beat ... he cut: plural, then singular
decisions.reason: The first verb is plural and the second singular, perhaps one craftsman among the workers or the master craftsman of verse 2. Either way, the sense is that the gold was made into thread for the weaving.

decisions.choice: the work of a skilled designer: as in 28:6
decisions.reason: A weaver who works patterns or figures into cloth. See the note at 28:6.

decisions.choice: passive: was beaten ... cut
decisions.reason: Balanced puts the sentence in the passive, since the Hebrew moves between "they" and "he" (m2). Literal keeps both.

decisions.choice: "láminas delgadas" ... "hilos"
decisions.reason: The gold was hammered into thin sheets and cut into strips for weaving (m1); "lámina" is the word used for the gold plate in 28:36 and verse 30, and "hilos" are threads.

decisions.choice: "lames minces" ... "fils" (R "fines feuilles")
decisions.reason: The gold was hammered into thin sheets and cut into strips for weaving (m1); "lame" is the word used for the gold plate in 28:36 and verse 30. Readable says "feuilles", the everyday word for beaten metal.

decisions.choice: "kufua" ... "mabamba membamba" ... "nyuzi"
decisions.reason: "Kufua" is to beat metal out, as for the hammered work of 25:31; "bamba" is the word used for the gold plate in 28:36 and verse 30, and "nyuzi" are threads (m1).

source.text: כְּתֵפֹ֥ת עָֽשׂוּ־ל֖וֹ חֹבְרֹ֑ת עַל־שְׁנֵ֥י קְצוֹתָ֖יו חֻבָּֽר׃

records.literal_gloss: Shoulder-pieces they made for it, joining; at its two ends it was joined.

en.L: Shoulder pieces they made for it, joining [it]; at its two ends it was joined.
en.B: They made shoulder pieces for the ephod to join it together; it was fastened at its two ends.
en.R: They made shoulder straps for the ephod, attached at its two ends to hold it together.

es.L: Hombreras le hicieron, que [lo] unían; en sus dos extremos fue unido.
es.B: Le hicieron hombreras al efod para unirlo; quedó sujeto por sus dos extremos.
es.R: Le hicieron al efod dos tirantes, sujetos a sus dos extremos, para mantenerlo unido.

fr.L: Des épaulettes ils lui firent, qui [le] joignaient ; à ses deux extrémités il fut joint.
fr.B: Ils firent pour l’éphod des épaulettes qui l’assemblaient ; il fut attaché à ses deux extrémités.
fr.R: Ils ont fait pour l’éphod deux bretelles, fixées à ses deux bouts pour le tenir ensemble.

sw.L: Vipande vya mabegani wakaifanyia, vya kuunganisha [efodi]; kwenye ncha zake mbili iliunganishwa.
sw.B: Waliifanyia efodi vipande vya mabegani vya kuiunganisha; iliungwa kwenye ncha zake mbili.
sw.R: Waliifanyia efodi kanda mbili za mabegani, zilizoshonwa kwenye ncha zake mbili ili kuishikilia pamoja.

decisions.choice: shoulder pieces joining: as in 28:7
decisions.reason: Straps over the shoulders that joined the front and back of the ephod. See the note at 28:7.

decisions.choice: shoulder straps
decisions.reason: As in 28:7, Readable says "straps" for the shoulder pieces.

source.text: וְחֵ֨שֶׁב אֲפֻדָּת֜וֹ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָלָ֗יו מִמֶּ֣נּוּ הוּא֮ כְּמַעֲשֵׂהוּ֒ זָהָ֗ב תְּכֵ֧לֶת וְאַרְגָּמָ֛ן וְתוֹלַ֥עַת שָׁנִ֖י וְשֵׁ֣שׁ מָשְׁזָ֑ר כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־מֹשֶֽׁה׃

records.literal_gloss: And [the] band of its binding which [is] on it, from it it [is], like its work: gold, violet and purple and scarlet of crimson and fine twisted linen, as had commanded Yahweh Moses.

en.L: And the band of its fastening, which [was] upon it, [was] of one [piece] with it, like its work: gold, blue and purple and scarlet [yarn] and fine twisted linen, as {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had commanded Moses.
en.B: The woven band that went around it to fasten it was made the same way, in one piece with the ephod, of gold, of blue, purple and scarlet yarn, and of fine twisted linen, as {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had commanded Moses.
en.R: The ephod had a woven belt made in one piece with it, from the same gold thread, fine linen, and blue, purple and red yarn. They made it as {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had commanded Moses.

es.L: Y la banda para ceñirlo, que [estaba] sobre él, [era] de una [pieza] con él, como su obra: oro, [hilo] azul y púrpura y escarlata, y lino fino torcido, como {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} había mandado a Moisés.
es.B: La banda tejida que lo rodeaba para ceñirlo se hizo de la misma manera, en una sola pieza con el efod, de oro, de hilo azul, púrpura y escarlata, y de lino fino torcido, como {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} había mandado a Moisés.
es.R: El efod tenía un cinturón tejido hecho en una sola pieza con él, con el mismo hilo de oro, lino fino e hilo azul, púrpura y rojo. Lo hicieron como {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} había mandado a Moisés.

fr.L: Et la bande de son attache, qui [était] sur lui, [était] d’une [seule pièce] avec lui, comme son ouvrage : or, [fil] bleu et pourpre et écarlate, et fin lin retors, comme {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} l’avait ordonné à Moïse.
fr.B: La bande tissée qui en faisait le tour pour l’attacher fut faite de la même manière, d’une seule pièce avec l’éphod, d’or, de fil bleu, pourpre et écarlate, et de fin lin retors, comme {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} l’avait ordonné à Moïse.
fr.R: L’éphod avait une bande tissée qui lui servait de ceinture, faite d’une seule pièce avec lui, avec le même fil d’or, le même fin lin et le même fil bleu, pourpre et rouge. Ils l’ont faite comme {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} l’avait ordonné à Moïse.

sw.L: Na ukanda wa kuifunga, uliokuwa juu yake, [ulikuwa] wa [kipande kimoja] nayo, kama kazi yake: dhahabu, [uzi wa] samawati na zambarau na rangi nyekundu, na kitani safi iliyosokotwa, kama {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alivyomwamuru Musa.
sw.B: Ukanda uliofumwa unaoizunguka ili kuifunga ulifanywa kwa namna ileile, kipande kimoja na efodi, kwa dhahabu, kwa uzi wa samawati, wa zambarau na wa rangi nyekundu, na kwa kitani safi iliyosokotwa, kama {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alivyomwamuru Musa.
sw.R: Efodi ilikuwa na mkanda uliofumwa pamoja nayo kama kipande kimoja, kwa uzi uleule wa dhahabu, kitani safi, na uzi wa samawati, wa zambarau na mwekundu. Waliufanya kama {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alivyomwamuru Musa.

decisions.choice: the band of its fastening, from it: as in 28:8
decisions.reason: A woven waistband made as part of the ephod, not a separate belt. See the notes at 28:8.

decisions.choice: as Yahweh had commanded Moses: the refrain
decisions.reason: See the note at verse 1. This is the second of the seven times the words close a section of verses 1-31.

decisions.choice: woven belt
decisions.reason: As in 28:8, Readable says "belt" for the band.

source.text: וַֽיַּעֲשׂוּ֙ אֶת־אַבְנֵ֣י הַשֹּׁ֔הַם מֻֽסַבֹּ֖ת מִשְׁבְּצֹ֣ת זָהָ֑ב מְפֻתָּחֹת֙ פִּתּוּחֵ֣י חוֹתָ֔ם עַל־שְׁמ֖וֹת בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

records.literal_gloss: And they made the stones of onyx, surrounded [with] settings of gold, engraved [with the] engravings of a seal, according to [the] names of [the] sons of Israel.

en.L: And they made the onyx stones, mounted [in] settings of gold, engraved [like the] engravings of a seal with the names of the sons of Israel.
en.B: They prepared the onyx stones, mounted them in settings of gold filigree, and engraved them, as a seal is engraved, with the names of the sons of Israel.
en.R: They set the onyx stones in gold settings. Then they carved the names of Jacob's sons on them, the way a seal is carved.

es.L: E hicieron las piedras de ónice, rodeadas [de] engastes de oro, grabadas [como] grabados de sello con los nombres de los hijos de Israel.
es.B: Prepararon las piedras de ónice, las montaron en engastes de filigrana de oro y grabaron en ellas, como se graba un sello, los nombres de los hijos de Israel.
es.R: Montaron las piedras de ónice en engastes de oro. Luego tallaron en ellas los nombres de los hijos de Jacob, como se talla un sello.

fr.L: Et ils firent les pierres d’onyx, entourées [de] chatons d’or, gravées [comme les] gravures d’un sceau des noms des fils d’Israël.
fr.B: Ils préparèrent les pierres d’onyx, les enchâssèrent dans des chatons d’or en filigrane et y gravèrent, comme on grave un sceau, les noms des fils d’Israël.
fr.R: Ils ont fixé les pierres d’onyx dans des montures d’or. Puis ils y ont gravé les noms des fils de Jacob, comme on grave un sceau.

sw.L: Wakayafanya mawe ya onikisi, yakiwa yamezungushiwa vikalio vya dhahabu, yamechorwa [kama] michoro ya muhuri majina ya wana wa Israeli.
sw.B: Waliviandaa vito vya onikisi, wakavitia katika vikalio vya dhahabu iliyosokotwa, wakachora juu yake, kama muhuri unavyochorwa, majina ya wana wa Israeli.
sw.R: Walivitia vito vya onikisi katika vikalio vya dhahabu. Kisha wakachonga juu yake majina ya wana wa Yakobo, kama muhuri unavyochongwa.

decisions.choice: onyx stones in gold settings, engraved like a seal: as in 28:9-11
decisions.reason: See the notes at 28:9-11 on the onyx stone, the seal engraving and the gold settings.

decisions.choice: the names of the sons of Israel: the twelve sons of Jacob
decisions.reason: As in 28:9-10, the names are those of Jacob's twelve sons, six on each stone.

decisions.choice: Jacob's sons
decisions.reason: Readable says Jacob, the man also called Israel, so that "sons of Israel" is not read as the whole people (28:9).

source.text: וַיָּ֣שֶׂם אֹתָ֗ם עַ֚ל כִּתְפֹ֣ת הָאֵפֹ֔ד אַבְנֵ֥י זִכָּר֖וֹן לִבְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־מֹשֶֽׁה׃פ

records.literal_gloss: And he put them on [the] shoulder-pieces of the ephod, stones of remembrance for [the] sons of Israel, as had commanded Yahweh Moses.

en.L: And he put them on the shoulder pieces of the ephod, stones of remembrance for the sons of Israel, as {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had commanded Moses.
en.B: Bezalel set them on the shoulder pieces of the ephod as stones of remembrance for the sons of Israel, as {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had commanded Moses.
en.R: Bezalel fastened the stones on the shoulder straps of the ephod. They would remind {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of the tribes of Israel. It was all done as {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had commanded Moses.

es.L: Y las puso sobre las hombreras del efod, piedras de memoria para los hijos de Israel, como {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} había mandado a Moisés.
es.B: Bezalel las colocó sobre las hombreras del efod para que fueran piedras de memoria de los hijos de Israel, como {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} había mandado a Moisés.
es.R: Bezalel sujetó las piedras en los tirantes del efod. Le recordarían {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} las tribus de Israel. Todo se hizo como {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} había mandado a Moisés.

fr.L: Et il les mit sur les épaulettes de l’éphod, pierres de souvenir pour les fils d’Israël, comme {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} l’avait ordonné à Moïse.
fr.B: Betsaleel les plaça sur les épaulettes de l’éphod pour qu’elles soient des pierres de souvenir pour les fils d’Israël, comme {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} l’avait ordonné à Moïse.
fr.R: Betsaleel a fixé les pierres sur les bretelles de l’éphod. Elles rappelleraient {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} les tribus d’Israël. Tout a été fait comme {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} l’avait ordonné à Moïse.

sw.L: Akayaweka juu ya vipande vya mabegani vya efodi, mawe ya ukumbusho kwa ajili ya wana wa Israeli, kama {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alivyomwamuru Musa.
sw.B: Bezaleli aliviweka juu ya vipande vya mabegani vya efodi viwe vito vya ukumbusho kwa ajili ya wana wa Israeli, kama {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alivyomwamuru Musa.
sw.R: Bezaleli alivifunga vito hivyo kwenye kanda za mabegani za efodi. Vingemkumbusha {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} makabila ya Israeli. Yote yalifanyika kama {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alivyomwamuru Musa.

decisions.choice: stones of remembrance: as in 28:12
decisions.reason: The stones bring the tribes before God. See the note at 28:12.

decisions.choice: as Yahweh had commanded Moses: the refrain
decisions.reason: See the note at verse 1. This is the third of the seven times the words close a section of verses 1-31.

decisions.choice: Bezalel
decisions.reason: As in verse 2, Balanced and Readable name the one meant by "he". Readable says whom the stones remind, as in 28:12.

source.text: וַיַּ֧עַשׂ אֶת־הַחֹ֛שֶׁן מַעֲשֵׂ֥ה חֹשֵׁ֖ב כְּמַעֲשֵׂ֣ה אֵפֹ֑ד זָהָ֗ב תְּכֵ֧לֶת וְאַרְגָּמָ֛ן וְתוֹלַ֥עַת שָׁנִ֖י וְשֵׁ֥שׁ מָשְׁזָֽר׃

records.literal_gloss: And he made the breastpiece, [the] work of a skilled designer, like [the] work of [the] ephod: gold, violet and purple and scarlet of crimson and fine twisted linen.

en.L: And he made the breastpiece, [the] work of a skilled designer, like the work of the ephod: gold, blue and purple and scarlet [yarn] and fine twisted linen.
en.B: He made the breastpiece with a designer's skill, worked like the ephod, of gold, of blue, purple and scarlet yarn, and of fine twisted linen.
en.R: Bezalel made the breastpiece the same way as the ephod. It was skilled work, made from gold thread, fine linen, and blue, purple and red yarn.

es.L: E hizo el pectoral, obra de diseñador hábil, como la obra del efod: oro, [hilo] azul y púrpura y escarlata, y lino fino torcido.
es.B: Hizo el pectoral con arte de diseñador, labrado como el efod, de oro, de hilo azul, púrpura y escarlata, y de lino fino torcido.
es.R: Bezalel hizo el pectoral de la misma manera que el efod. Fue un trabajo hábil, hecho con hilo de oro, lino fino e hilo azul, púrpura y rojo.

fr.L: Et il fit le pectoral, ouvrage de dessinateur habile, comme l’ouvrage de l’éphod : or, [fil] bleu et pourpre et écarlate, et fin lin retors.
fr.B: Il fit le pectoral avec l’art d’un dessinateur, travaillé comme l’éphod, d’or, de fil bleu, pourpre et écarlate, et de fin lin retors.
fr.R: Betsaleel a fait le pectoral de la même manière que l’éphod. C’était un travail habile, fait de fil d’or, de fin lin et de fil bleu, pourpre et rouge.

sw.L: Akakifanya kifuko cha kifuani, kazi ya mbunifu stadi, kama kazi ya efodi: dhahabu, [uzi wa] samawati na zambarau na rangi nyekundu, na kitani safi iliyosokotwa.
sw.B: Alikifanya kifuko cha kifuani kwa ustadi wa mbunifu, kikiwa kimefanywa kama efodi, kwa dhahabu, kwa uzi wa samawati, wa zambarau na wa rangi nyekundu, na kwa kitani safi iliyosokotwa.
sw.R: Bezaleli alishona kifuko cha kifuani kwa namna ileile kama efodi. Ilikuwa kazi ya ustadi, kwa uzi wa dhahabu, kitani safi, na uzi wa samawati, wa zambarau na mwekundu.

decisions.choice: the breastpiece: as in 28:15
decisions.reason: The square pouch worn on the chest, fastened to the ephod. Here it is called simply "the breastpiece"; 28:15 calls it "the breastpiece of judgment". See the note there.

decisions.choice: Bezalel
decisions.reason: As in verse 2, Readable names the one meant by "he".

source.text: רָב֧וּעַ הָיָ֛ה כָּפ֖וּל עָשׂ֣וּ אֶת־הַחֹ֑שֶׁן זֶ֧רֶת אָרְכּ֛וֹ וְזֶ֥רֶת רָחְבּ֖וֹ כָּפֽוּל׃

records.literal_gloss: Square it was; folded double they made the breastpiece, a span its length and a span its width, folded double.

en.L: It was square; they made the breastpiece folded double, a span its length and a span its width, folded double.
en.B: It was square. They made the breastpiece folded double, {{units:about 9 inches|a span}} long and {{units:about 9 inches|a span}} wide when doubled.
en.R: The breastpiece was square, {{units:about 9 inches|a span}} long and {{units:about 9 inches|a span}} wide. They made it from cloth folded double.

es.L: Cuadrado era; doblado hicieron el pectoral, un palmo su longitud y un palmo su anchura, doblado.
es.B: Era cuadrado. Hicieron el pectoral doblado, de {{units:unos 23 centímetros|un palmo}} de largo y {{units:unos 23 centímetros|un palmo}} de ancho una vez doblado.
es.R: El pectoral era cuadrado, de {{units:unos 23 centímetros|un palmo}} de largo y {{units:unos 23 centímetros|un palmo}} de ancho. Lo hicieron con tela doblada.

fr.L: Carré il était ; plié en deux ils firent le pectoral, un empan sa longueur et un empan sa largeur, plié en deux.
fr.B: Il était carré. Ils firent le pectoral plié en deux, {{units:d’environ 23 centimètres|d’un empan}} de long et {{units:d’environ 23 centimètres|d’un empan}} de large une fois plié.
fr.R: Le pectoral était carré, {{units:d’environ 23 centimètres|d’un empan}} de long et {{units:d’environ 23 centimètres|d’un empan}} de large. Ils l’ont fait avec un tissu plié en deux.

sw.L: Kilikuwa cha mraba; wakakifanya kifuko cha kifuani kilichokunjwa mara mbili, shibiri moja urefu wake na shibiri moja upana wake, kilichokunjwa mara mbili.
sw.B: Kilikuwa cha mraba. Walikifanya kifuko cha kifuani kilichokunjwa mara mbili, chenye urefu wa {{units:karibu sentimita 23|shibiri moja}} na upana wa {{units:karibu sentimita 23|shibiri moja}} kikiwa kimekunjwa.
sw.R: Kifuko cha kifuani kilikuwa cha mraba, urefu wake {{units:karibu sentimita 23|shibiri moja}} na upana wake {{units:karibu sentimita 23|shibiri moja}}. Walikishona kwa kitambaa kilichokunjwa mara mbili.

decisions.choice: a span: about 9 inches, half a cubit
decisions.reason: A span was the distance from the tip of the thumb to the tip of the little finger with the hand spread, half a cubit, about 9 inches (23 centimeters). See 28:16.

decisions.choice: folded double: as in 28:16
decisions.reason: The cloth was folded over to make two layers, probably forming a pouch (28:16, 30). The word is said twice here, at the beginning and the end of the description.

decisions.choice: about 9 inches / a span
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable give the modern measure, with "a span" as the units setting. Literal keeps "a span".

source.text: וַיְמַלְאוּ־ב֔וֹ אַרְבָּעָ֖ה ט֣וּרֵי אָ֑בֶן ט֗וּר אֹ֤דֶם פִּטְדָה֙ וּבָרֶ֔קֶת הַטּ֖וּר הָאֶחָֽד׃

records.literal_gloss: And they filled in it four rows of stone: a row of ruby, topaz and beryl [was] the first row;

en.L: And they filled in it four rows of stones: a row of carnelian, topaz and beryl [was] the first row;
en.B: They set four rows of stones on it. In the first row were a carnelian, a topaz and a beryl;
en.R: They attached four rows of precious stones to it. The first row had a carnelian, a topaz and a beryl.

es.L: Y llenaron en él cuatro hileras de piedras: una hilera de cornalina, topacio y berilo [era] la primera hilera;
es.B: Engastaron en él cuatro hileras de piedras. En la primera hilera había una cornalina, un topacio y un berilo;
es.R: Le sujetaron cuatro hileras de piedras preciosas. La primera hilera tenía una cornalina, un topacio y un berilo.

fr.L: Et ils remplirent en lui quatre rangées de pierres : une rangée de cornaline, topaze et béryl [était] la première rangée ;
fr.B: Ils y sertirent quatre rangées de pierres. Dans la première rangée, il y avait une cornaline, une topaze et un béryl ;
fr.R: Ils y ont fixé quatre rangées de pierres précieuses. La première rangée avait une cornaline, une topaze et un béryl.

sw.L: Wakajaza ndani yake safu nne za vito: safu ya akiki, topazi na berili [ilikuwa] safu ya kwanza;
sw.B: Walipachika juu yake safu nne za vito. Katika safu ya kwanza kulikuwa na akiki, topazi na berili;
sw.R: Walipachika juu yake safu nne za vito vya thamani. Safu ya kwanza ilikuwa na akiki, topazi na berili.

decisions.choice: the twelve stones: as in 28:17-20
decisions.reason: The same twelve stones as in 28:17-20, in the same order. Several cannot be identified with certainty; the names given follow the note at 28:17.

source.text: וְהַטּ֖וּר הַשֵּׁנִ֑י נֹ֥פֶךְ סַפִּ֖יר וְיָהֲלֹֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: and the second row: turquoise, sapphire and emerald;

en.L: and the second row: turquoise, sapphire and emerald;
en.B: in the second row, a turquoise, a sapphire and an emerald;
en.R: The second row had a turquoise, a sapphire and an emerald.

es.L: y la segunda hilera: turquesa, zafiro y esmeralda;
es.B: en la segunda hilera, una turquesa, un zafiro y una esmeralda;
es.R: La segunda hilera tenía una turquesa, un zafiro y una esmeralda.

fr.L: et la deuxième rangée : turquoise, saphir et émeraude ;
fr.B: dans la deuxième rangée, une turquoise, un saphir et une émeraude ;
fr.R: La deuxième rangée avait une turquoise, un saphir et une émeraude.

sw.L: na safu ya pili: feruzi, yakuti samawi na zumaridi;
sw.B: katika safu ya pili, feruzi, yakuti samawi na zumaridi;
sw.R: Safu ya pili ilikuwa na feruzi, yakuti samawi na zumaridi.

decisions.choice: turquoise, sapphire, emerald: as in 28:18
decisions.reason: See the notes at 28:17-18.

source.text: וְהַטּ֖וּר הַשְּׁלִישִׁ֑י לֶ֥שֶׁם שְׁב֖וֹ וְאַחְלָֽמָה׃

records.literal_gloss: and the third row: jacinth, agate and amethyst;

en.L: and the third row: jacinth, agate and amethyst;
en.B: in the third row, a jacinth, an agate and an amethyst;
en.R: The third row had a jacinth, an agate and an amethyst.

es.L: y la tercera hilera: jacinto, ágata y amatista;
es.B: en la tercera hilera, un jacinto, un ágata y una amatista;
es.R: La tercera hilera tenía un jacinto, un ágata y una amatista.

fr.L: et la troisième rangée : hyacinthe, agate et améthyste ;
fr.B: dans la troisième rangée, une hyacinthe, une agate et une améthyste ;
fr.R: La troisième rangée avait une hyacinthe, une agate et une améthyste.

sw.L: na safu ya tatu: hiasinti, ageti na amethisto;
sw.B: katika safu ya tatu, hiasinti, ageti na amethisto;
sw.R: Safu ya tatu ilikuwa na hiasinti, ageti na amethisto.

decisions.choice: jacinth, agate, amethyst: as in 28:19
decisions.reason: See the notes at 28:17 and 28:19.

source.text: וְהַטּוּר֙ הָֽרְבִיעִ֔י תַּרְשִׁ֥ישׁ שֹׁ֖הַם וְיָשְׁפֵ֑ה מֽוּסַבֹּ֛ת מִשְׁבְּצ֥וֹת זָהָ֖ב בְּמִלֻּאֹתָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: and the fourth row: chrysolite, onyx and jasper; surrounded [with] settings of gold in their fillings.

en.L: and the fourth row: chrysolite, onyx and jasper; mounted [in] settings of gold in their mountings.
en.B: and in the fourth row, a chrysolite, an onyx and a jasper. They were mounted in gold filigree settings.
en.R: The fourth row had a chrysolite, an onyx and a jasper. Each stone was set in gold.

es.L: y la cuarta hilera: crisólito, ónice y jaspe; rodeados [de] engastes de oro en sus engarces.
es.B: y en la cuarta hilera, un crisólito, un ónice y un jaspe. Estaban montados en engastes de filigrana de oro.
es.R: La cuarta hilera tenía un crisólito, un ónice y un jaspe. Cada piedra estaba montada en oro.

fr.L: et la quatrième rangée : chrysolithe, onyx et jaspe ; entourées [de] chatons d’or dans leurs garnitures.
fr.B: et dans la quatrième rangée, une chrysolithe, un onyx et un jaspe. Elles étaient serties dans des chatons d’or en filigrane.
fr.R: La quatrième rangée avait une chrysolithe, un onyx et un jaspe. Chaque pierre était sertie dans de l’or.

sw.L: na safu ya nne: krisolito, onikisi na yaspi; vikiwa vimezungushiwa vikalio vya dhahabu katika vipachikio vyake.
sw.B: na katika safu ya nne, krisolito, onikisi na yaspi. Vilipachikwa katika vikalio vya dhahabu iliyosokotwa.
sw.R: Safu ya nne ilikuwa na krisolito, onikisi na yaspi. Kila kito kilipachikwa katika dhahabu.

decisions.choice: chrysolite, onyx, jasper: as in 28:20
decisions.reason: See the notes at 28:17 and 28:20.

decisions.choice: mounted in settings of gold: each stone in its own mounting
decisions.reason: As in 28:20, each gem had its own gold setting, probably of filigree work (28:11).

source.text: וְ֠הָאֲבָנִים עַל־שְׁמֹ֨ת בְּנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֥ל הֵ֛נָּה שְׁתֵּ֥ים עֶשְׂרֵ֖ה עַל־שְׁמֹתָ֑ם פִּתּוּחֵ֤י חֹתָם֙ אִ֣ישׁ עַל־שְׁמ֔וֹ לִשְׁנֵ֥ים עָשָׂ֖ר שָֽׁבֶט׃

records.literal_gloss: And the stones [were] according to [the] names of [the] sons of Israel, they [were] twelve, according to their names; engravings of a seal, each according to his name, for [the] twelve tribes.

en.L: And the stones [were] according to the names of the sons of Israel; they [were] twelve, according to their names; [with the] engravings of a seal, each according to his name, for the twelve tribes.
en.B: The stones bore the names of the sons of Israel, twelve of them to match their names. Each was engraved like a seal with its own name, for the twelve tribes.
en.R: Each of the twelve stones had the name of one son of Israel carved on it like a seal. The stones stood for the twelve tribes.

es.L: Y las piedras [eran] según los nombres de los hijos de Israel; doce [eran], según sus nombres; [como] grabados de sello, cada una según su nombre, para las doce tribus.
es.B: Las piedras llevaban los nombres de los hijos de Israel, doce, conforme a sus nombres. Cada una estaba grabada como un sello con su propio nombre, para las doce tribus.
es.R: Cada una de las doce piedras tenía grabado, como un sello, el nombre de un hijo de Israel. Las piedras representaban a las doce tribus.

fr.L: Et les pierres [étaient] selon les noms des fils d’Israël ; elles [étaient] douze, selon leurs noms ; [comme les] gravures d’un sceau, chacune selon son nom, pour les douze tribus.
fr.B: Les pierres portaient les noms des fils d’Israël, douze, d’après leurs noms. Chacune était gravée comme un sceau, avec son propre nom, pour les douze tribus.
fr.R: Sur chacune des douze pierres était gravé, comme sur un sceau, le nom d’un fils d’Israël. Les pierres représentaient les douze tribus.

sw.L: Na mawe hayo [yalikuwa] kulingana na majina ya wana wa Israeli; [yalikuwa] kumi na mawili, kulingana na majina yao; [kama] michoro ya muhuri, kila moja kulingana na jina lake, kwa ajili ya makabila kumi na mawili.
sw.B: Vito hivyo vilibeba majina ya wana wa Israeli, kumi na viwili kwa majina yao. Kila kimoja kilichorwa kama muhuri kwa jina lake, kwa ajili ya makabila kumi na mawili.
sw.R: Kila kimoja cha vito kumi na viwili kilichongwa jina la mwana mmoja wa Israeli, kama muhuri. Vito hivyo viliwakilisha makabila kumi na mawili.

decisions.choice: the names of the sons of Israel ... the twelve tribes: as in 28:21
decisions.reason: Each stone carried the name of one of Jacob's sons, standing for the tribe descended from him. See the notes at 28:21.

source.text: וַיַּעֲשׂ֧וּ עַל־הַחֹ֛שֶׁן שַׁרְשְׁרֹ֥ת גַּבְלֻ֖ת מַעֲשֵׂ֣ה עֲבֹ֑ת זָהָ֖ב טָהֽוֹר׃

records.literal_gloss: And they made on the breastpiece chains of twisting, [the] work of cordage, [of] pure gold.

en.L: And they made on the breastpiece chains of twisted [work], [the] work of cordage, [of] pure gold.
en.B: On the breastpiece they made chains of pure gold, twisted like cords.
en.R: They braided pure gold into chains like ropes for the breastpiece.

es.L: E hicieron sobre el pectoral cadenillas de trenzado, obra de cordonería, [de] oro puro.
es.B: Para el pectoral hicieron cadenillas de oro puro, trenzadas como cordones.
es.R: Trenzaron oro puro para hacer cadenillas, como cuerdas, para el pectoral.

fr.L: Et ils firent sur le pectoral des chaînettes tressées, ouvrage de cordier, [d’]or pur.
fr.B: Pour le pectoral, ils firent des chaînettes d’or pur, tressées comme des cordons.
fr.R: Ils ont tressé de l’or pur pour faire des chaînettes, comme des cordes, pour le pectoral.

sw.L: Wakafanya juu ya kifuko cha kifuani mikufu iliyosokotwa, kazi ya kusokota kamba, [ya] dhahabu safi.
sw.B: Walikifanyia kifuko cha kifuani mikufu ya dhahabu safi, iliyosokotwa kama kamba.
sw.R: Walisokota dhahabu safi kuwa mikufu kama kamba kwa ajili ya kifuko cha kifuani.

decisions.choice: chains of twisting, the work of cordage: as in 28:14, 22
decisions.reason: Chains of gold wire braided like a cord, not made of links. See the notes at 28:14 and 28:22. Verses 15-21 tell how the breastpiece was fastened to the ephod, following 28:22-28.

source.text: וַֽיַּעֲשׂ֗וּ שְׁתֵּי֙ מִשְׁבְּצֹ֣ת זָהָ֔ב וּשְׁתֵּ֖י טַבְּעֹ֣ת זָהָ֑ב וַֽיִּתְּנ֗וּ אֶת־שְׁתֵּי֙ הַטַּבָּעֹ֔ת עַל־שְׁנֵ֖י קְצ֥וֹת הַחֹֽשֶׁן׃

records.literal_gloss: And they made two settings of gold and two rings of gold, and they put the two rings on [the] two ends of the breastpiece.

en.L: And they made two settings of gold and two rings of gold, and they put the two rings on the two ends of the breastpiece.
en.B: They also made a pair of gold filigree settings and a pair of gold rings; the rings they put on two corners of the breastpiece.
en.R: They also made two gold settings and two gold rings. They attached the rings to the top two corners of the breastpiece.

es.L: E hicieron dos engastes de oro y dos anillos de oro, y pusieron los dos anillos en los dos extremos del pectoral.
es.B: Hicieron también un par de engastes de filigrana de oro y un par de anillos de oro; los anillos los pusieron en dos esquinas del pectoral.
es.R: También hicieron dos engastes de oro y dos anillos de oro. Sujetaron los anillos a las dos esquinas de arriba del pectoral.

fr.L: Et ils firent deux chatons d’or et deux anneaux d’or, et ils mirent les deux anneaux aux deux extrémités du pectoral.
fr.B: Ils firent aussi une paire de chatons d’or en filigrane et une paire d’anneaux d’or ; les anneaux, ils les mirent à deux coins du pectoral.
fr.R: Ils ont aussi fait deux montures d’or et deux anneaux d’or. Ils ont fixé les anneaux aux deux coins du haut du pectoral.

sw.L: Wakafanya vikalio viwili vya dhahabu na pete mbili za dhahabu, wakaziweka pete hizo mbili kwenye ncha mbili za kifuko cha kifuani.
sw.B: Walifanya pia vikalio viwili vya dhahabu iliyosokotwa na pete mbili za dhahabu; pete hizo wakaziweka kwenye pembe mbili za kifuko cha kifuani.
sw.R: Pia walitengeneza vikalio viwili vya dhahabu na pete mbili za dhahabu. Walizifunga pete hizo kwenye pembe mbili za juu za kifuko cha kifuani.

decisions.choice: two settings of gold: those on the shoulder pieces
decisions.reason: These are the settings of 28:13 and 28:25, on the shoulder pieces of the ephod, to which the chains are tied in verse 18.

decisions.choice: the two ends: the upper corners, as in 28:23
decisions.reason: The rings take the gold chains from the shoulder pieces, so they are at the two upper corners. See the note at 28:23.

decisions.choice: top
decisions.reason: As in 28:23, Readable says which corners are meant.

source.text: וַֽיִּתְּנ֗וּ שְׁתֵּי֙ הָעֲבֹתֹ֣ת הַזָּהָ֔ב עַל־שְׁתֵּ֖י הַטַּבָּעֹ֑ת עַל־קְצ֖וֹת הַחֹֽשֶׁן׃

records.literal_gloss: And they put [the] two cords of the gold on [the] two rings on [the] ends of the breastpiece.

en.L: And they put the two gold cords on the two rings at the ends of the breastpiece.
en.B: They tied the two gold cords into the two rings at the corners of the breastpiece.
en.R: They tied one end of each gold chain to one of these rings.

es.L: Y pusieron los dos cordones de oro en los dos anillos, en los extremos del pectoral.
es.B: Ataron los dos cordones de oro a los dos anillos de las esquinas del pectoral.
es.R: Ataron un extremo de cada cadenilla de oro a uno de esos anillos.

fr.L: Et ils mirent les deux cordons d’or dans les deux anneaux, aux extrémités du pectoral.
fr.B: Ils attachèrent les deux cordons d’or aux deux anneaux qui étaient aux coins du pectoral.
fr.R: Ils ont attaché un bout de chaque chaînette d’or à l’un de ces anneaux.

sw.L: Wakaziweka kamba mbili za dhahabu kwenye pete mbili, kwenye ncha za kifuko cha kifuani.
sw.B: Walizifunga kamba mbili za dhahabu kwenye pete mbili zilizokuwa pembeni mwa kifuko cha kifuani.
sw.R: Walifunga ncha moja ya kila mkufu wa dhahabu kwenye mojawapo ya pete hizo.

decisions.choice: the two cords of gold: the corded chains, as in 28:24
decisions.reason: The braided gold chains of verse 15, here called "cords". See the note at 28:24.

decisions.choice: chain ... one end of each
decisions.reason: As in 28:24, Readable says "chains" so the reader can follow them, and makes clear that only one end is tied here (verse 18).

source.text: וְאֵ֨ת שְׁתֵּ֤י קְצוֹת֙ שְׁתֵּ֣י הָֽעֲבֹתֹ֔ת נָתְנ֖וּ עַל־שְׁתֵּ֣י הַֽמִּשְׁבְּצֹ֑ת וַֽיִּתְּנֻ֛ם עַל־כִּתְפֹ֥ת הָאֵפֹ֖ד אֶל־מ֥וּל פָּנָֽיו׃

records.literal_gloss: And [the] two ends of [the] two cords they put on [the] two settings, and they put them on [the] shoulder-pieces of the ephod at [the] front of its face.

en.L: And the two ends of the two cords they put on the two settings, and they put them on the shoulder pieces of the ephod at its front.
en.B: The remaining ends of the cords went to the two settings, which they fixed to the front of the ephod on its shoulder pieces.
en.R: They tied the other ends of the chains to the two gold settings on the shoulder straps. This attached the breastpiece to the front of the ephod.

es.L: Y los dos extremos de los dos cordones los pusieron sobre los dos engastes, y los pusieron sobre las hombreras del efod, en su parte delantera.
es.B: Los otros extremos de los cordones fueron a los dos engastes, que fijaron en las hombreras del efod por delante.
es.R: Ataron los otros extremos de las cadenillas a los dos engastes de oro de los tirantes. Así el pectoral quedó sujeto a la parte delantera del efod.

fr.L: Et les deux bouts des deux cordons, ils les mirent sur les deux chatons, et ils les mirent sur les épaulettes de l’éphod, sur le devant.
fr.B: Les deux autres bouts des cordons allèrent aux deux chatons, qu’ils fixèrent sur le devant de l’éphod, à ses épaulettes.
fr.R: Ils ont attaché les autres bouts des chaînettes aux deux montures d’or des bretelles. Ainsi, le pectoral a été fixé au devant de l’éphod.

sw.L: Na ncha mbili za kamba hizo mbili wakazitia kwenye vikalio viwili, wakaziweka juu ya vipande vya mabegani vya efodi, upande wake wa mbele.
sw.B: Ncha nyingine za kamba hizo zilifungwa kwenye vikalio viwili, ambavyo walivishikamanisha na vipande vya mabegani vya efodi upande wa mbele.
sw.R: Walifunga ncha nyingine za mikufu kwenye vikalio viwili vya dhahabu vilivyokuwa kwenye kanda za mabegani. Hivyo kifuko cha kifuani kilishikamana na upande wa mbele wa efodi.

decisions.choice: the two ends on the two settings: as in 28:25
decisions.reason: The chains run from the settings on the shoulder pieces down to the top corners of the breastpiece. See the note at 28:25.

decisions.choice: remaining / other
decisions.reason: One end of each cord is already tied to the breastpiece (verse 17). As in 28:25, Balanced and Readable say these are the other ends.

source.text: וַֽיַּעֲשׂ֗וּ שְׁתֵּי֙ טַבְּעֹ֣ת זָהָ֔ב וַיָּשִׂ֕ימוּ עַל־שְׁנֵ֖י קְצ֣וֹת הַחֹ֑שֶׁן עַל־שְׂפָת֕וֹ אֲשֶׁ֛ר אֶל־עֵ֥בֶר הָאֵפֹ֖ד בָּֽיְתָה׃

records.literal_gloss: And they made two rings of gold and they put [them] on [the] two ends of the breastpiece, on its edge which [is] toward [the] side of the ephod, inward.

en.L: And they made two rings of gold and put [them] on the two ends of the breastpiece, on its edge which [was] toward the side of the ephod, inward.
en.B: They made two gold rings and set them at the two lower ends of the breastpiece, on its inner edge, the edge facing the ephod.
en.R: They made two more gold rings and attached them to the bottom corners of the breastpiece, on the back edge that faces the ephod.

es.L: E hicieron dos anillos de oro y [los] pusieron en los dos extremos del pectoral, en su borde que [estaba] hacia el lado del efod, por dentro.
es.B: Hicieron dos anillos de oro y los colocaron en los dos extremos inferiores del pectoral, en su borde interior, el que daba al efod.
es.R: Hicieron otros dos anillos de oro y los sujetaron a las esquinas de abajo del pectoral, en el borde de atrás que da al efod.

fr.L: Et ils firent deux anneaux d’or et [les] mirent aux deux extrémités du pectoral, sur son bord qui [était] du côté de l’éphod, en dedans.
fr.B: Ils firent deux anneaux d’or et les placèrent aux deux extrémités inférieures du pectoral, sur son bord intérieur, celui qui touchait l’éphod.
fr.R: Ils ont fait deux autres anneaux d’or et les ont fixés aux coins du bas du pectoral, sur le bord arrière, contre l’éphod.

sw.L: Wakafanya pete mbili za dhahabu, wakaziweka kwenye ncha mbili za kifuko cha kifuani, kwenye ukingo wake uliokuwa upande wa efodi, ndani.
sw.B: Walifanya pete mbili za dhahabu, wakaziweka kwenye ncha mbili za chini za kifuko cha kifuani, kwenye ukingo wake wa ndani, unaoelekea efodi.
sw.R: Walitengeneza pete nyingine mbili za dhahabu, wakazifunga kwenye pembe za chini za kifuko cha kifuani, kwenye ukingo wa nyuma unaoelekea efodi.

decisions.choice: the two ends, on the inner edge: the lower corners, as in 28:26
decisions.reason: These rings are at the lower corners of the breastpiece, on the side facing the ephod. See the note at 28:26.

decisions.choice: lower / bottom
decisions.reason: As in 28:26, Balanced and Readable say which corners are meant, since the upper ones already have rings (verse 16).

source.text: וַֽיַּעֲשׂוּ֮ שְׁתֵּ֣י טַבְּעֹ֣ת זָהָב֒ וַֽיִּתְּנֻ֡ם עַל־שְׁתֵּי֩ כִתְפֹ֨ת הָאֵפֹ֤ד מִלְמַ֨טָּה֙ מִמּ֣וּל פָּנָ֔יו לְעֻמַּ֖ת מֶחְבַּרְתּ֑וֹ מִמַּ֕עַל לְחֵ֖שֶׁב הָאֵפֹֽד׃

records.literal_gloss: And they made two rings of gold and they put them on [the] two shoulder-pieces of the ephod, below, at [the] front of its face, close to its joining, above [the] band of the ephod.

en.L: And they made two rings of gold and put them on the two shoulder pieces of the ephod, below, at the front of it, close to its joining, above the band of the ephod.
en.B: They made another two gold rings and put them on the two shoulder pieces of the ephod, low on its front, near where it is joined, above the woven band of the ephod.
en.R: They made two more gold rings and put them low on the front of the shoulder straps of the ephod, near where the straps join it, just above the woven belt.

es.L: E hicieron dos anillos de oro y los pusieron sobre las dos hombreras del efod, abajo, en su parte delantera, junto a su unión, encima de la banda del efod.
es.B: Hicieron otros dos anillos de oro y los pusieron en las dos hombreras del efod, en la parte baja de su lado delantero, cerca de donde se une, encima de la banda tejida del efod.
es.R: Hicieron otros dos anillos de oro y los pusieron abajo, en la parte delantera de los tirantes del efod, cerca de donde los tirantes se unen a él, justo encima del cinturón tejido.

fr.L: Et ils firent deux anneaux d’or et les mirent sur les deux épaulettes de l’éphod, en bas, sur le devant, près de sa jointure, au-dessus de la bande de l’éphod.
fr.B: Ils firent deux autres anneaux d’or et les mirent sur les deux épaulettes de l’éphod, au bas de sa face avant, près de l’endroit où il est joint, au-dessus de la bande tissée de l’éphod.
fr.R: Ils ont fait encore deux anneaux d’or et les ont mis au bas des bretelles de l’éphod, sur le devant, près de l’endroit où les bretelles s’y joignent, juste au-dessus de la bande qui sert de ceinture.

sw.L: Wakafanya pete mbili za dhahabu, wakaziweka juu ya vipande viwili vya mabegani vya efodi, chini, upande wake wa mbele, karibu na maungio yake, juu ya ukanda wa efodi.
sw.B: Walifanya pete nyingine mbili za dhahabu, wakaziweka kwenye vipande viwili vya mabegani vya efodi, chini upande wake wa mbele, karibu na mahali inapounganishwa, juu ya ukanda uliofumwa wa efodi.
sw.R: Walitengeneza pete nyingine mbili za dhahabu, wakaziweka chini upande wa mbele wa kanda za mabegani za efodi, karibu na mahali kanda hizo zinapoungana nayo, juu kidogo ya mkanda uliofumwa.

decisions.choice: below, close to its joining: as in 28:27
decisions.reason: The rings were set low on the shoulder pieces, near the seam, just above the woven band. See the note at 28:27.

source.text: וַיִּרְכְּס֣וּ אֶת־הַחֹ֡שֶׁן מִטַּבְּעֹתָיו֩ אֶל־טַבְּעֹ֨ת הָאֵפֹ֜ד בִּפְתִ֣יל תְּכֵ֗לֶת לִֽהְיֹת֙ עַל־חֵ֣שֶׁב הָאֵפֹ֔ד וְלֹֽא־יִזַּ֣ח הַחֹ֔שֶׁן מֵעַ֖ל הָאֵפֹ֑ד כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־מֹשֶֽׁה׃

records.literal_gloss: And they bound the breastpiece by its rings to [the] rings of the ephod with a cord of violet, to be on [the] band of the ephod, and not would come loose the breastpiece from on the ephod, as had commanded Yahweh Moses.

en.L: And they bound the breastpiece by its rings to the rings of the ephod with a cord of blue, to be upon the band of the ephod, and [so that] the breastpiece would not come loose from upon the ephod, as {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had commanded Moses.
en.B: They bound the breastpiece by its rings to the rings of the ephod with a blue cord, so that it lay on the woven band of the ephod and did not come away from it, as {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had commanded Moses.
en.R: They used a blue cord to tie the bottom rings of the breastpiece to the rings on the ephod. So the breastpiece rested above the belt and did not come loose from the ephod. They did it as {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had commanded Moses.

es.L: Y ataron el pectoral por sus anillos a los anillos del efod con un cordón azul, para que estuviera sobre la banda del efod, y [para que] no se soltara el pectoral de encima del efod, como {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} había mandado a Moisés.
es.B: Ataron el pectoral por sus anillos a los anillos del efod con un cordón azul, de modo que quedara sobre la banda tejida del efod y no se separara de él, como {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} había mandado a Moisés.
es.R: Usaron un cordón azul para atar los anillos de abajo del pectoral a los anillos del efod. Así el pectoral quedó encima del cinturón y no se soltaba del efod. Lo hicieron como {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} había mandado a Moisés.

fr.L: Et ils attachèrent le pectoral par ses anneaux aux anneaux de l’éphod avec un cordon bleu, pour qu’il soit sur la bande de l’éphod, et [pour que] le pectoral ne se détache pas de dessus l’éphod, comme {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} l’avait ordonné à Moïse.
fr.B: Ils attachèrent le pectoral par ses anneaux aux anneaux de l’éphod avec un cordon bleu, de sorte qu’il reposait sur la bande tissée de l’éphod et ne s’en détachait pas, comme {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} l’avait ordonné à Moïse.
fr.R: Avec un cordon bleu, ils ont attaché les anneaux du bas du pectoral aux anneaux de l’éphod. Ainsi, le pectoral restait au-dessus de la bande tissée et ne se détachait pas de l’éphod. Ils l’ont fait comme {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} l’avait ordonné à Moïse.

sw.L: Wakakifunga kifuko cha kifuani kwa pete zake kwenye pete za efodi kwa kamba ya samawati, ili kiwe juu ya ukanda wa efodi, na [ili] kifuko cha kifuani kisiachane na efodi, kama {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alivyomwamuru Musa.
sw.B: Walikifunga kifuko cha kifuani kwa pete zake kwenye pete za efodi kwa kamba ya samawati, ili kikae juu ya ukanda uliofumwa wa efodi na kisitengane nayo, kama {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alivyomwamuru Musa.
sw.R: Walitumia kamba ya samawati kufunga pete za chini za kifuko cha kifuani kwenye pete za efodi. Hivyo kifuko cha kifuani kilikaa juu ya mkanda, wala hakikulegea kutoka kwenye efodi. Walifanya hivyo kama {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alivyomwamuru Musa.

decisions.choice: a cord of blue: as in 28:28
decisions.reason: See the notes at 28:28. Gold chains at the top and blue cord at the bottom held the breastpiece flat on the ephod.

decisions.choice: the breastpiece: the Urim and Thummim are not mentioned
decisions.reason: The account of the breastpiece ends here without the Urim and Thummim of 28:30. They were not made by the craftsmen; Moses puts them into the breastpiece when he dresses Aaron (Leviticus 8:8).

decisions.choice: as Yahweh had commanded Moses: the refrain
decisions.reason: See the note at verse 1. This is the fourth of the seven times the words close a section of verses 1-31.

source.text: וַיַּ֛עַשׂ אֶת־מְעִ֥יל הָאֵפֹ֖ד מַעֲשֵׂ֣ה אֹרֵ֑ג כְּלִ֖יל תְּכֵֽלֶת׃

records.literal_gloss: And he made the robe of the ephod, [the] work of a weaver, entirely [of] violet.

en.L: And he made the robe of the ephod, [the] work of a weaver, entirely [of] blue.
en.B: Bezalel made the robe that goes under the ephod, a weaver's work, all of blue.
en.R: Bezalel made the robe worn under the ephod. It was woven all of blue.

es.L: E hizo el manto del efod, obra de tejedor, enteramente [de] azul.
es.B: Bezalel hizo el manto que va debajo del efod, obra de tejedor, todo de azul.
es.R: Bezalel hizo el manto que se lleva debajo del efod. Estaba tejido todo de azul.

fr.L: Et il fit la robe de l’éphod, ouvrage de tisserand, entièrement [de] bleu.
fr.B: Betsaleel fit la robe qui se porte sous l’éphod, ouvrage de tisserand, toute de bleu.
fr.R: Betsaleel a fait la robe qui se porte sous l’éphod. Elle était tissée tout en bleu.

sw.L: Akalifanya joho la efodi, kazi ya mfumaji, lote [la] samawati.
sw.B: Bezaleli alilifanya joho linalovaliwa chini ya efodi, kazi ya mfumaji, lote la samawati.
sw.R: Bezaleli alishona joho linalovaliwa chini ya efodi. Lilifumwa lote kwa samawati.

decisions.choice: the robe of the ephod, entirely of blue: as in 28:31
decisions.reason: The long robe worn under the ephod, all of the violet-blue material. See the notes at 28:31.

decisions.choice: the work of a weaver: plain woven cloth
decisions.reason: A weaver of plain cloth, as against the patterned work of the skilled designer (verse 3). The detail is not in chapter 28.

decisions.choice: Bezalel ... goes under / worn under
decisions.reason: As in verse 2, Balanced and Readable name the one meant by "he". As in 28:31, they say how the robe is worn with the ephod.

decisions.choice: "obra de tejedor"
decisions.reason: A weaver of plain cloth (m2), kept apart from the "diseñador hábil" of verses 3 and 8 and the "bordador" of verse 29.

decisions.choice: "ouvrage de tisserand"
decisions.reason: A weaver of plain cloth (m2), kept apart from the "dessinateur habile" of verses 3 and 8 and the "brodeur" of verse 29.

decisions.choice: "kazi ya mfumaji"
decisions.reason: A weaver of plain cloth (m2), kept apart from the "mbunifu stadi" of verses 3 and 8 and the "mtarizi" of verse 29.

source.text: וּפִֽי־הַמְּעִ֥יל בְּתוֹכ֖וֹ כְּפִ֣י תַחְרָ֑א שָׂפָ֥ה לְפִ֛יו סָבִ֖יב לֹ֥א יִקָּרֵֽעַ׃

records.literal_gloss: And [the] opening of the robe in its middle [was] like [the] opening of a coat of mail, an edge to its opening all around; not it would be torn.

en.L: And the opening of the robe [was] in its middle, like the opening of a coat of mail, an edge [belonging] to its opening all around; it would not be torn.
en.B: The opening of the robe was in the middle, like the neck of a coat of armor, with a hem all around it so that it would not rip.
en.R: The robe had a hole in the middle for the head, like the neck of a soldier's coat of armor. A strong band went around the edge so that it would not rip.

es.L: Y la abertura del manto [estaba] en medio de él, como la abertura de una cota de malla, un borde [tenía] su abertura alrededor; no se rasgaría.
es.B: La abertura del manto estaba en el centro, como el cuello de una cota de malla, con un ribete alrededor para que no se rompiera.
es.R: El manto tenía un agujero en el centro para la cabeza, como el cuello de la armadura de un soldado. Una tira fuerte rodeaba el borde para que no se rompiera.

fr.L: Et l’ouverture de la robe [était] en son milieu, comme l’ouverture d’une cotte de mailles, un bord [appartenant] à son ouverture tout autour ; elle ne serait pas déchirée.
fr.B: L’ouverture de la robe était au milieu, comme le col d’une cotte de mailles, avec une bordure tout autour pour qu’elle ne se déchire pas.
fr.R: La robe avait un trou au milieu pour la tête, comme le col de l’armure d’un soldat. Une bande solide en faisait le tour pour que la robe ne se déchire pas.

sw.L: Na tundu la joho [lilikuwa] katikati yake, kama tundu la deraya, ukingo [ukiwa] kwa tundu lake kulizunguka; lisichanike.
sw.B: Tundu la joho lilikuwa katikati, kama shingo ya deraya, lenye pindo kulizunguka ili lisichanike.
sw.R: Joho lilikuwa na tundu katikati kwa ajili ya kichwa, kama shingo ya deraya ya askari. Ukanda imara ulizunguka ukingo wake ili lisichanike.

decisions.choice: like the opening of a coat of mail: as in 28:32
decisions.reason: The meaning of the rare word is uncertain; it may be a coat of armor or a collar. Either way the opening was strongly edged. See the note at 28:32.

decisions.choice: it would not be torn: the purpose of the edge
decisions.reason: As in 28:32, the words give the purpose of the hem.

decisions.choice: for the head ... soldier's ... strong band
decisions.reason: As in 28:32, Readable says what the opening was for and what the coat of armor was.

source.text: וַֽיַּעֲשׂוּ֙ עַל־שׁוּלֵ֣י הַמְּעִ֔יל רִמּוֹנֵ֕י תְּכֵ֥לֶת וְאַרְגָּמָ֖ן וְתוֹלַ֣עַת שָׁנִ֑י מָשְׁזָֽר׃

records.literal_gloss: And they made on [the] hems of the robe pomegranates of violet and purple and scarlet of crimson, twisted.

en.L: And they made on the hem of the robe pomegranates of blue and purple and scarlet [yarn], twisted.
en.B: On the hem of the robe they made pomegranates of twisted blue, purple and scarlet yarn.
en.R: On the bottom edge of the robe they made pomegranates out of blue, purple and red yarn.

es.L: E hicieron en la orla del manto granadas de [hilo] azul y púrpura y escarlata, torcido.
es.B: En la orla del manto hicieron granadas de hilo torcido azul, púrpura y escarlata.
es.R: En el borde de abajo del manto hicieron granadas de hilo azul, púrpura y rojo.

fr.L: Et ils firent sur le bord de la robe des grenades de [fil] bleu et pourpre et écarlate, retors.
fr.B: Sur la bordure de la robe, ils firent des grenades de fil retors bleu, pourpre et écarlate.
fr.R: Sur le bord du bas de la robe, ils ont fait des grenades en fil bleu, pourpre et rouge.

sw.L: Wakafanya katika pindo la joho makomamanga ya [uzi wa] samawati na zambarau na rangi nyekundu, uliosokotwa.
sw.B: Katika pindo la joho walifanya makomamanga ya uzi uliosokotwa wa samawati, wa zambarau na wa rangi nyekundu.
sw.R: Kwenye pindo la chini la joho walitengeneza makomamanga kwa uzi wa samawati, wa zambarau na mwekundu.

decisions.choice: pomegranates on the hem: as in 28:33
decisions.reason: Balls or tassels of colored yarn in the shape of the fruit. See the note at 28:33.

decisions.choice: twisted: the yarn itself was twisted
alternatives: pomegranates of blue, purple and scarlet yarn and fine twisted linen
decisions.reason: Elsewhere "twisted" describes the fine linen (verse 2). Here it follows the three colors with no word for linen, so the text as it stands says the yarn was twisted, spun from several strands. The Samaritan Pentateuch and the Septuagint read "and fine twisted linen", adding linen to the materials of the pomegranates. The Hebrew text is followed here.

source.text: וַיַּעֲשׂ֥וּ פַעֲמֹנֵ֖י זָהָ֣ב טָה֑וֹר וַיִּתְּנ֨וּ אֶת־הַפַּֽעֲמֹנִ֜ים בְּת֣וֹךְ הָרִמֹּנִ֗ים עַל־שׁוּלֵ֤י הַמְּעִיל֙ סָבִ֔יב בְּת֖וֹךְ הָרִמֹּנִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: And they made bells of pure gold, and they put the bells between the pomegranates on [the] hems of the robe all around, between the pomegranates.

en.L: And they made bells of pure gold, and they put the bells between the pomegranates on the hem of the robe all around, between the pomegranates.
en.B: They made bells of pure gold too, and put the bells between the pomegranates all the way around the hem of the robe.
en.R: They also made bells of pure gold. They put them between the pomegranates all around the bottom edge of the robe.

es.L: E hicieron campanillas de oro puro, y pusieron las campanillas entre las granadas en la orla del manto alrededor, entre las granadas.
es.B: Hicieron también campanillas de oro puro y las pusieron entre las granadas por toda la orla del manto.
es.R: También hicieron campanillas de oro puro. Las pusieron entre las granadas, por todo el borde de abajo del manto.

fr.L: Et ils firent des clochettes d’or pur, et ils mirent les clochettes entre les grenades sur le bord de la robe tout autour, entre les grenades.
fr.B: Ils firent aussi des clochettes d’or pur et les mirent entre les grenades, sur tout le tour de la bordure de la robe.
fr.R: Ils ont aussi fait des clochettes d’or pur. Ils les ont mises entre les grenades, tout autour du bord du bas de la robe.

sw.L: Wakafanya kengele za dhahabu safi, wakaziweka kengele hizo katikati ya makomamanga katika pindo la joho pande zote, katikati ya makomamanga.
sw.B: Walifanya pia kengele za dhahabu safi, wakaziweka katikati ya makomamanga kuzunguka pindo lote la joho.
sw.R: Pia walitengeneza kengele za dhahabu safi. Walizitia katikati ya makomamanga, kuzunguka pindo lote la chini la joho.

decisions.choice: bells of pure gold: as in 28:33-35
decisions.reason: The bells rang as Aaron moved in the holy place. Here they are "pure" gold, a detail not given in 28:33. See the notes at 28:33 and 28:35.

decisions.choice: between the pomegranates (once)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says "between the pomegranates" twice. Balanced and Readable say it once; Literal keeps both.

source.text: פַּעֲמֹ֤ן וְרִמֹּן֙ פַּעֲמֹ֣ן וְרִמֹּ֔ן עַל־שׁוּלֵ֥י הַמְּעִ֖יל סָבִ֑יב לְשָׁרֵ֕ת כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־מֹשֶֽׁה׃ס

records.literal_gloss: A bell and a pomegranate, a bell and a pomegranate on [the] hems of the robe all around, for serving, as had commanded Yahweh Moses.

en.L: A bell and a pomegranate, a bell and a pomegranate [were] on the hem of the robe all around, for ministering, as {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had commanded Moses.
en.B: Bell and pomegranate, bell and pomegranate, they went all around the hem of the robe, which was worn for ministering, as {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had commanded Moses.
en.R: The bells and pomegranates took turns all around the edge of the robe. Aaron would wear it when he served. They made it as {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had commanded Moses.

es.L: Una campanilla y una granada, una campanilla y una granada [había] en la orla del manto alrededor, para ministrar, como {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} había mandado a Moisés.
es.B: Campanilla y granada, campanilla y granada, iban por toda la orla del manto, que se llevaba para ministrar, como {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} había mandado a Moisés.
es.R: Las campanillas y las granadas se alternaban por todo el borde del manto. Aarón lo llevaría cuando sirviera. Lo hicieron como {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} había mandado a Moisés.

fr.L: Une clochette et une grenade, une clochette et une grenade [étaient] sur le bord de la robe tout autour, pour officier, comme {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} l’avait ordonné à Moïse.
fr.B: Clochette et grenade, clochette et grenade, elles faisaient tout le tour de la bordure de la robe, que l’on portait pour le service, comme {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} l’avait ordonné à Moïse.
fr.R: Les clochettes et les grenades alternaient tout autour du bord de la robe. Aaron la porterait quand il ferait le service. Ils l’ont faite comme {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} l’avait ordonné à Moïse.

sw.L: Kengele na komamanga, kengele na komamanga [vilikuwa] katika pindo la joho pande zote, kwa ajili ya kuhudumu, kama {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alivyomwamuru Musa.
sw.B: Kengele na komamanga, kengele na komamanga, vilizunguka pindo lote la joho, lililovaliwa kwa ajili ya kuhudumu, kama {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alivyomwamuru Musa.
sw.R: Kengele na makomamanga yalifuatana kwa zamu kuzunguka pindo lote la joho. Haruni angelivaa alipohudumu. Walilifanya kama {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alivyomwamuru Musa.

decisions.choice: a bell and a pomegranate, a bell and a pomegranate: alternating
decisions.reason: As in 28:34, the repeated words picture bells and pomegranates set in turn all around the hem.

decisions.choice: for ministering: worn for service in the sanctuary
decisions.reason: The robe was worn when Aaron served in the holy place (28:35).

decisions.choice: as Yahweh had commanded Moses: the refrain
decisions.reason: See the note at verse 1. This is the fifth of the seven times the words close a section of verses 1-31.

decisions.choice: took turns ... Aaron would wear it when he served
decisions.reason: As in 28:34, Readable states the pattern. It also says who wore the robe for service (28:35).

source.text: וַֽיַּעֲשׂ֛וּ אֶת־הַכָּתְנֹ֥ת שֵׁ֖שׁ מַעֲשֵׂ֣ה אֹרֵ֑ג לְאַהֲרֹ֖ן וּלְבָנָֽיו׃

records.literal_gloss: And they made the tunics [of] fine linen, [the] work of a weaver, for Aaron and for his sons,

en.L: And they made the tunics [of] fine linen, [the] work of a weaver, for Aaron and for his sons,
en.B: They made tunics of fine linen, a weaver's work, for Aaron and his sons,
en.R: They also wove tunics of fine linen for Aaron and his sons.

es.L: E hicieron las túnicas [de] lino fino, obra de tejedor, para Aarón y para sus hijos,
es.B: Hicieron túnicas de lino fino, obra de tejedor, para Aarón y sus hijos,
es.R: También tejieron túnicas de lino fino para Aarón y sus hijos.

fr.L: Et ils firent les tuniques [de] fin lin, ouvrage de tisserand, pour Aaron et pour ses fils,
fr.B: Ils firent des tuniques de fin lin, ouvrage de tisserand, pour Aaron et ses fils,
fr.R: Ils ont aussi tissé des tuniques de fin lin pour Aaron et ses fils.

sw.L: Wakazifanya kanzu [za] kitani safi, kazi ya mfumaji, kwa ajili ya Haruni na kwa ajili ya wanawe,
sw.B: Walishona kanzu za kitani safi, kazi ya mfumaji, kwa ajili ya Haruni na wanawe,
sw.R: Pia walifuma kanzu za kitani safi kwa ajili ya Haruni na wanawe.

decisions.choice: the tunics of fine linen: as in 28:39-40
decisions.reason: The long linen shirts worn next to the body, for Aaron and for his sons. See the notes at 28:4 and 28:39.

decisions.choice: they made: the sentence runs on to verse 29
decisions.reason: The tunics, the turban, the caps, the undergarments and the sash are all objects of this one verb, and the refrain closes the list at verse 29.

source.text: וְאֵת֙ הַמִּצְנֶ֣פֶת שֵׁ֔שׁ וְאֶת־פַּאֲרֵ֥י הַמִּגְבָּעֹ֖ת שֵׁ֑שׁ וְאֶת־מִכְנְסֵ֥י הַבָּ֖ד שֵׁ֥שׁ מָשְׁזָֽר׃

records.literal_gloss: and the turban [of] fine linen, and the ornaments of the caps [of] fine linen, and the undergarments of the linen [of] fine twisted linen,

en.L: and the turban [of] fine linen, and the ornaments of the caps [of] fine linen, and the linen undergarments [of] fine twisted linen,
en.B: the turban of fine linen, the decorative caps of fine linen, and the linen undergarments of fine twisted linen,
en.R: They made the turban and the caps from fine linen, and the underwear from fine twisted linen.

es.L: y el turbante [de] lino fino, y los adornos de los gorros [de] lino fino, y los calzones de lino [de] lino fino torcido,
es.B: el turbante de lino fino, los gorros de gala de lino fino y los calzones de lino, de lino fino torcido,
es.R: Hicieron el turbante y los gorros de lino fino, y la ropa interior de lino fino torcido.

fr.L: et le turban [de] fin lin, et les parures des bonnets [de] fin lin, et les caleçons de lin [de] fin lin retors,
fr.B: le turban de fin lin, les bonnets d’apparat de fin lin, et les caleçons de lin, en fin lin retors,
fr.R: Ils ont fait le turban et les bonnets en fin lin, et les sous-vêtements en fin lin retors.

sw.L: na kilemba [cha] kitani safi, na mapambo ya kofia [ya] kitani safi, na suruali za ndani za kitani [za] kitani safi iliyosokotwa,
sw.B: kilemba cha kitani safi, kofia za mapambo za kitani safi, na suruali za ndani za kitani, za kitani safi iliyosokotwa,
sw.R: Walishona kilemba na kofia kwa kitani safi, na nguo za ndani kwa kitani safi iliyosokotwa.

decisions.choice: the ornaments of the caps: the caps as headdresses
decisions.reason: The first word is used of a headdress or ornament worn on the head (Isaiah 61:3, 10; Ezekiel 44:18). Here it probably describes the sons' caps as wound headdresses of linen. See the note at 28:40 on the caps.

decisions.choice: the linen undergarments: as in 28:42
decisions.reason: Short linen trousers for modesty at the altar. See the notes at 28:42.

decisions.choice: decorative caps (Balanced); caps (Readable)
decisions.reason: As in 28:40, Balanced and Readable say "caps". Literal keeps "the ornaments of the caps". Readable says "underwear", as in 28:42.

decisions.choice: "los adornos de los gorros" (L); "los gorros de gala" (B)
decisions.reason: The first word names a headdress worn as an ornament (m1). Literal keeps both words; Balanced says the caps were for ceremony, as the English says "decorative caps". "Gorros" as in 28:40.

decisions.choice: "les parures des bonnets" (L); "les bonnets d'apparat" (B)
decisions.reason: The first word names a headdress worn as an ornament (m1). Literal keeps both words; Balanced says the caps were for ceremony, as the English says "decorative caps". "Bonnets" as in 28:40.

decisions.choice: "mapambo ya kofia" (L); "kofia za mapambo" (B)
decisions.reason: The first word names a headdress worn as an ornament (m1). Literal keeps the order of the two words; Balanced makes it "decorative caps", as the English does. "Kofia" as in 28:40.

source.text: וְֽאֶת־הָאַבְנֵ֞ט שֵׁ֣שׁ מָשְׁזָ֗ר וּתְכֵ֧לֶת וְאַרְגָּמָ֛ן וְתוֹלַ֥עַת שָׁנִ֖י מַעֲשֵׂ֣ה רֹקֵ֑ם כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־מֹשֶֽׁה׃ס

records.literal_gloss: and the sash [of] fine twisted linen and violet and purple and scarlet of crimson, [the] work of an embroiderer, as had commanded Yahweh Moses.

en.L: and the sash [of] fine twisted linen and blue and purple and scarlet [yarn], [the] work of an embroiderer, as {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had commanded Moses.
en.B: and the sash of fine twisted linen with blue, purple and scarlet yarn, worked in colors by an embroiderer, as {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had commanded Moses.
en.R: They made the sash from fine twisted linen and blue, purple and red yarn, with colorful designs by a skilled worker. Everything was made as {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had commanded Moses.

es.L: y la faja [de] lino fino torcido y [hilo] azul y púrpura y escarlata, obra de bordador, como {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} había mandado a Moisés.
es.B: y la faja de lino fino torcido con hilo azul, púrpura y escarlata, labrada en colores por un bordador, como {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} había mandado a Moisés.
es.R: Hicieron la faja de lino fino torcido y de hilo azul, púrpura y rojo, con dibujos de colores hechos por un artesano hábil. Todo se hizo como {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} había mandado a Moisés.

fr.L: et la ceinture [de] fin lin retors et [de fil] bleu et pourpre et écarlate, ouvrage de brodeur, comme {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} l’avait ordonné à Moïse.
fr.B: et la ceinture de fin lin retors avec du fil bleu, pourpre et écarlate, travaillée en couleurs par un brodeur, comme {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} l’avait ordonné à Moïse.
fr.R: Ils ont fait la ceinture en fin lin retors et en fil bleu, pourpre et rouge, avec des motifs colorés faits par un artisan habile. Tout a été fait comme {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} l’avait ordonné à Moïse.

sw.L: na mshipi [wa] kitani safi iliyosokotwa na [uzi wa] samawati na zambarau na rangi nyekundu, kazi ya mtarizi, kama {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alivyomwamuru Musa.
sw.B: na mshipi wa kitani safi iliyosokotwa pamoja na uzi wa samawati, wa zambarau na wa rangi nyekundu, uliotariziwa kwa rangi na mtarizi, kama {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alivyomwamuru Musa.
sw.R: Walishona mshipi kwa kitani safi iliyosokotwa na uzi wa samawati, wa zambarau na mwekundu, wenye nakshi za rangi zilizofanywa na fundi stadi. Kila kitu kilifanywa kama {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alivyomwamuru Musa.

decisions.choice: the sash of linen and colored yarn: its materials are given here
decisions.reason: 28:39 says only that the sash was the work of an embroiderer. Here its materials are named: fine twisted linen and the three colors of yarn, the same as the ephod. See the note at 28:39.

decisions.choice: as Yahweh had commanded Moses: the refrain
decisions.reason: See the note at verse 1. This is the sixth of the seven times the words close a section of verses 1-31.

source.text: וַֽיַּעֲשׂ֛וּ אֶת־צִ֥יץ נֵֽזֶר־הַקֹּ֖דֶשׁ זָהָ֣ב טָה֑וֹר וַיִּכְתְּב֣וּ עָלָ֗יו מִכְתַּב֙ פִּתּוּחֵ֣י חוֹתָ֔ם קֹ֖דֶשׁ לַיהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And they made the plate of the crown of holiness [of] pure gold, and they wrote on it a writing, engravings of a seal: holiness to Yahweh.

en.L: And they made the plate of the crown of holiness [of] pure gold, and they wrote on it a writing [like the] engravings of a seal: "Holiness to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}."
en.B: From pure gold they made the plate that is the holy crown, and they engraved it, as a seal is engraved, with the words "Holy to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}."
en.R: They made the plate for the holy crown from pure gold. They carved these words on it the way a seal is carved: "Holy to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}."

es.L: E hicieron la lámina de la diadema de santidad [de] oro puro, y escribieron sobre ella una inscripción [como] grabados de sello: «Santidad {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}».
es.B: Con oro puro hicieron la lámina que es la diadema santa, y grabaron en ella, como se graba un sello, las palabras «Santo para {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}».
es.R: Hicieron de oro puro la lámina para la diadema santa. Tallaron en ella estas palabras, como se talla un sello: «Santo para {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}».

fr.L: Et ils firent la lame du diadème de sainteté [d’]or pur, et ils écrivirent sur elle une inscription [comme les] gravures d’un sceau : « Sainteté {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}. »
fr.B: En or pur, ils firent la lame qui est le diadème sacré, et ils y gravèrent, comme on grave un sceau, les mots : « Saint pour {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. »
fr.R: Ils ont fait en or pur la lame du diadème sacré. Ils y ont gravé ces mots, comme on grave un sceau : « Saint pour {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. »

sw.L: Wakafanya bamba la taji ya utakatifu [kwa] dhahabu safi, wakaandika juu yake maandishi [kama] michoro ya muhuri: "Utakatifu kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}."
sw.B: Kwa dhahabu safi walifanya bamba ambalo ndilo taji takatifu, wakachora juu yake, kama muhuri unavyochorwa, maneno haya: "Mtakatifu wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}."
sw.R: Walitengeneza kwa dhahabu safi bamba la taji takatifu. Walichonga juu yake maneno haya, kama muhuri unavyochongwa: "Mtakatifu wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}."

decisions.choice: the plate of the holy crown: the gold plate is the crown
decisions.reason: The gold plate tied to the turban is itself called "the holy crown", as in 29:6. See the note at 28:36.

decisions.choice: Holy to Yahweh: as in 28:36
decisions.reason: The one who wears these words is set apart to Yahweh. See the note at 28:36.

decisions.choice: Holy to the LORD
decisions.reason: As in 28:36, Literal keeps the noun "Holiness"; Balanced and Readable say "Holy", the natural form of an inscription.

source.text: וַיִּתְּנ֤וּ עָלָיו֙ פְּתִ֣יל תְּכֵ֔לֶת לָתֵ֥ת עַל־הַמִּצְנֶ֖פֶת מִלְמָ֑עְלָה כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־מֹשֶֽׁה׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And they put on it a cord of violet to put [it] on the turban from above, as had commanded Yahweh Moses.

en.L: And they put on it a cord of blue, to fasten [it] on the turban above, as {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had commanded Moses.
en.B: To it they attached a cord of blue so that it could be fixed high on the turban, as {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had commanded Moses.
en.R: They tied a blue cord to it and fastened it high on the turban, as {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had commanded Moses.

es.L: Y le pusieron un cordón azul, para sujetar[la] sobre el turbante por arriba, como {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} había mandado a Moisés.
es.B: Le ataron un cordón azul para fijarla en lo alto del turbante, como {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} había mandado a Moisés.
es.R: Le ataron un cordón azul y la sujetaron en lo alto del turbante, como {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} había mandado a Moisés.

fr.L: Et ils mirent sur elle un cordon bleu, pour [la] fixer sur le turban, en haut, comme {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} l’avait ordonné à Moïse.
fr.B: Ils y attachèrent un cordon bleu pour la fixer en haut du turban, comme {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} l’avait ordonné à Moïse.
fr.R: Ils y ont attaché un cordon bleu et l’ont fixée en haut du turban, comme {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} l’avait ordonné à Moïse.

sw.L: Wakalitilia kamba ya samawati, ili [kulifunga] juu ya kilemba upande wa juu, kama {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alivyomwamuru Musa.
sw.B: Walilifungia kamba ya samawati ili lifungwe juu kwenye kilemba, kama {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alivyomwamuru Musa.
sw.R: Walifunga kamba ya samawati kwenye bamba hilo, wakalifunga juu kwenye kilemba, kama {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alivyomwamuru Musa.

decisions.choice: a cord of blue on the turban: as in 28:37
decisions.reason: The plate was tied to the front of the turban so that it rested on Aaron's forehead (28:37-38).

decisions.choice: as Yahweh had commanded Moses: the seventh time
decisions.reason: With these words the refrain sounds for the seventh time in verses 1-31, and the high priest's clothing is complete, ending with the words "Holy to Yahweh". See the note at verse 1.

source.text: וַתֵּ֕כֶל כָּל־עֲבֹדַ֕ת מִשְׁכַּ֖ן אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד וַֽיַּעֲשׂוּ֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל כְּ֠כֹל אֲשֶׁ֨ר צִוָּ֧ה יְהוָ֛ה אֶת־מֹשֶׁ֖ה כֵּ֥ן עָשֽׂוּ׃פ

records.literal_gloss: And was finished all [the] work of [the] tabernacle of [the] tent of meeting; and did [the] sons of Israel according to all that had commanded Yahweh Moses; so they did.
